title: RAW_UNSCREENED: f57v Nahinschrift und Zwischenfigurtext als Ableitung
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: Die vier figurnahen und vier zwischen den Figuren verlaufenden Texte auf f57v können eine Quelle→Folge-Relation oder zwei parallele Beschriftungsregister bilden.

design.scope_description: Nur die bereits gebundene f57v-Visualbeschreibung und vorhandene Locus-/Registertabellen; keine neue Bildauswertung.
design.mechanism: Jede figurnahe Einheit liefert einen Ausgangszustand; der Text zwischen zwei Figuren beschreibt das Ergebnis oder den Übergang des benachbarten Paars.
design.unit: The four nearby and four interfigure f57v inscriptions recorded in the existing source-bound visual report.
design.contrast: Abgeleitetes Übergangsregister versus zwei unabhängige Beschriftungsregister.
design.prediction: Die Ableitungslesung sagt eine positionsgebundene Relation zwischen jedem Zwischenfigurtext und seinen beiden Nachbarn voraus; die Parallelregisterlesung sagt keine solche Abhängigkeit und erlaubt eigenständige lokale Serien.
concrete_observations: The bound f57v report records four short inscriptions near the figures and four additional inscriptions radiating through the gaps between consecutive figures.
The same report explicitly records no drawn leader, bracket or separate enclosure assigning a nearby inscription to one figure.
linked_consequences: A repeated nearby-register pattern should be followed by a predictable transformation or relation in the intervening text, measured only on exact forms and order.
If the registers are parallel, changing endpoint pair types need not change the intervening item and no endpoint-to-middle mapping is required.
design.nearest_rival: Two independent lists placed in one circular composition, with proximity serving layout only.
design.distinguishing_observation: Freeze the four cyclic endpoint pairs before reading values and ask whether each intervening item has a repeatable endpoint-dependent form relation; absence of any such relation, especially with mixed endpoint pairs, favors independent registers. No label is called an observation merely because it is nearby.
assumption_costs: The four positions and cyclic adjacency are source-bound.
A semantic transition may be expressed by form relations without a confirmed word anchor.
No missing connector can be supplied by editorial proximity.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The report’s lack of connectors may mean the eight texts are simply separate labels, and an exact four-item sample is too small to distinguish derived relation from coincidental repetition.
